body:
ok i genuinely can't stop thinking about this one 🤍

speak now is the only album she's ever written completely alone — all 14 standard-edition tracks, no co-writers. grammy.com later called it 'a mic drop against critics,' with the no-co-writers credit line making the same statement the sales numbers did.

it opened to 1,047,000 copies in one week. the first album since lil wayne's tha carter III to clear a million in a single opening week, and an opening week that nearly doubled what fearless did. she became only the fourth woman ever to sell a million copies in a week, after britney spears, whitney houston, and norah jones.

tag whoever doubted her back then — you know they're eating their words now.

📷 speak now set, the eras tour, inglewood 2023 — paolo villanueva (cc by 2.0), via wikimedia commons.

why: IG sibling of the 09-11 heartbeat:era-deep-cut speak-now beat (GH issue #4069 fix, card t_42b5f6d8). Long-form, gush-first (feeling then the concrete facts), structurally and lexically diverged from the X post (>20%, re-verified by check-drafts.mjs's cross-post-similarity gate after a repair round). Hook shape = the contradiction. Sales/chart figures from the Vault item 'Speak Now sells over a million copies in a single week' (supabase/seed/content/speak-now.mjs:16-40), cited to Billboard + Grammy.com + The Boot: 1,047,000 week-one copies, first million-copy week since Lil Wayne's Tha Carter III, an opening week that 'nearly doubled what Fearless did' (Grammy.com's own framing), and the fourth-woman-ever detail (after Britney Spears, Whitney Houston, Norah Jones) — all in that Vault item. The no-co-writers/'mic drop against critics' claim is sourced from the separate Vault item 'Speak Now: the only album Taylor Swift has ever written entirely alone' (supabase/seed/content/speak-now.mjs:930-943), which scopes solo authorship to the 14 standard-edition tracks and names the deluxe bonus track 'If This Was a Movie' (Martin Johnson co-write) as the one exception — hence the 'all 14 standard-edition tracks' qualifier (added in a follow-up commit after an official codex review.sh finding flagged the unqualified claim as overstating the source). Nothing invented; an earlier draft's unsourced 'doubted her range/songwriting ability' framing was also removed after an independent cross-family review flagged it as not traceable to the source. Share hook ('tag whoever doubted her back then') grounded in the same no-co-writers detail as the X post. Era-matched credited speak-now Eras-Tour photo (inventory entry speaknow-inglewood-2023, added by PR #4062); photo-only per heartbeat media rule. Replaces the stale red-fallback queue pair, whose `why` field incorrectly claimed no cleared speak-now photo existed. Lyric-free, blocklist-safe. Re-drafted after the reaction-approval gate landed (RULINGS-SOCIAL-2 PR-D); body unchanged from the retired pre-gate draft, altText added, rescheduled.
